en.title: Keel
en.tagline: Tax does not go to a wallet. It goes into a position.
en.treasuryHint: Read from Venus when this page loaded. Nobody publishes it.
en.split: Every distribution: 70% holders, 30% project. Both constant, no setter.
en.auto: This vault settles itself every 5 minutes. You do not need to press anything.
en.manualHint: Only needed if the schedule ever stops. Anyone may call these; each pays the caller.
en.connect: Connect a wallet to use the manual fallback.
en.risk: A 3x position is liquidated by a 16.7% move against it. Venus and PancakeSwap are dependencies. Unaudited.

zh.title: Keel
zh.treasuryHint: 本页加载时从 Venus 读出,没有任何人对外公布这个数。
zh.split: 每次分配:持有者 70%、项目方 30%。两个数都写死在合约里,没有修改函数。
zh.auto: 这个金库每 5 分钟自动结算一次。你不需要按任何按钮。
zh.manualHint: 只在定时链条中断时才需要。任何人都可以调用,每一个都付赏金给调用者。
zh.connect: 连接钱包后可使用手动兜底。
zh.risk: 3 倍仓位在反向 16.7% 时会被清算。Venus 与 PancakeSwap 是依赖项。未经审计。
